judgment.reason: Both answers are byte-for-byte identical (824 chars, 92 words, same 'length' finish). Both are incomplete: the visible text cuts off mid-assertion in the second test and omits the required third test. Both implement the same flawed approach for general hashable elements—using SHA1 of string representations for non-primitives instead of leveraging native hashability—which fails for valid hashable types like tuples or frozensets, though it works for primitives. Since they are identical, they are equally correct and equally incomplete.
